scope_note: This identifies the 1895 joint book as a predecessor text and preserves both authorship and the cathartic-method vocabulary established in S2.
statement: Josef Breuer and Sigmund Freud jointly published Studies on Hysteria in 1895.
statement_zh: Josef Breuer 與 Sigmund Freud 在 1895 年共同出版《歇斯底里研究》。
